operations-panel.tsx.它把运行状态、配置备份和异常信息集中到一个页面；之后的 Demo 自动演练仍需作: It concentrates run status, configuration backup and error information on one page; the later Demo automated practice still needs to be enabled manually as a separate stage.
operations-panel.tsx.点击启动面板后，先看“启动自检”为通过；行情桥、历史时钟和后台研究合格后，才进入: After starting the panel, first confirm “Startup self-check” passes; enter Demo only after the quote bridge, history clock and background research are qualified.
operations-panel.tsx.先启动服务、验证连接、解除急停，再在同一处设置模型和多仓位参数并启用。非人工断线: Start the service, verify the connection and release the emergency stop, then set model and multi-position parameters and enable them in the same place. Non-manual disconnections attempt recovery; a manual emergency stop is never auto-released.
operations-panel.tsx.恢复风险、当前货币对/周期/模型，以及本机回测、前向、日志和演练记录。不会恢复配: Restores risk, the current pair/timeframe/model and local backtest, forward, journal and practice records. Pairing codes, account information and orders are never restored.

paper-panel.tsx.这里的买卖只改变浏览器本机的模拟账本。: Buying and selling here changes only the simulated ledger in this browser.
paper-panel.tsx.达到日内亏损上限后，本日不再允许新的模拟开仓。: After the intraday loss cap is reached, no new paper positions are allowed today.
paper-panel.tsx.没有模拟持仓。可使用上方按钮测试完整订单流程。: No paper positions. Use the buttons above to test the full order flow.

strategy-tournament.tsx.这里不寻找“保证盈利”的模型，而是用公开规则淘汰不稳定模型。: This does not hunt for “guaranteed profit” models; it eliminates unstable ones by public rules.
strategy-tournament.tsx.仅使用已校准的本机 MT4 历史；没有实际历史就不排名，不用演示数据补位。入选只: Only calibrated local MT4 history is used; without real history nothing is ranked and demo data is never substituted. Selection only enters the local forward-simulation candidate queue and places no orders.
strategy-tournament.tsx.左侧更慢、更稳；右侧更快、更积极。所有模型使用同一位置。: Slower and steadier on the left; faster and more aggressive on the right. All models use the same position.
strategy-tournament.tsx.交易数不足不会被判定为优秀。: Too few trades is never judged excellent.
strategy-tournament.tsx.使用样本外权益曲线的最大回撤。: Uses the max drawdown of the out-of-sample equity curve.
strategy-tournament.tsx.至少 2 个市场通过，模型才可进入前向模拟候选。: A model needs at least 2 passing markets to become a forward-simulation candidate.
strategy-tournament.tsx.按每个货币对的当前固定研究假设计入。: Charged per pair under the current fixed research assumptions.
strategy-tournament.tsx.前 70% 预热，最后 30% 统一比较。: First 70% warms up; the last 30% is compared uniformly.
strategy-tournament.tsx.候选不是启用: A candidate is not an enablement
strategy-tournament.tsx.当前已有达到两市场门槛的候选；它仍需在内部模拟与人工复核中继续观察。: A candidate has reached the two-market threshold; it still needs continued observation in internal simulation and human review.
strategy-tournament.tsx.目前没有模型达到两市场门槛；这是正常的研究结论，不应强行选择赢家。: No model has reached the two-market threshold yet; that is a normal research outcome, and winners should not be forced.
strategy-tournament.tsx.无订单、无账户、无自动执行: No orders, no account, no automatic execution
strategy-tournament.tsx.本页只读取 127.0.0.1 的本机历史，并将候选记录到浏览器本机。: This page only reads local history from 127.0.0.1 and records candidates in this browser.
